avis.titre: Glowy, Soft, Hydrated Skin ✨ Milky Toner Magic! 💗🌸💦Glowy, Soft, Hydrated Skin ✨ Milky Toner Magic! 💗🌸💦
avis.texte: ✨ Hydrating, silky, and instantly glowy — this milky toner makes my skin look so smooth and fresh! 💗💦 🌸💗 The MediCube PDRN Pink Niacinamide Milky Toner is a total game-changer 😍💦. It gives me soft, glassy, hydrated skin every single time I use it. The packaging is beautiful, and I love that the expiration date is printed clearly (mine says 02/12/2028) 🤯💕. Plus, you get 150 mL — it lasts a long time! The texture is a silky, thicker milky toner that melts into skin without feeling sticky. No strong fragrance, so it’s perfect for sensitive skin. I’ve used it with and without the MediCube Booster Pro, and it performs beautifully either way! It layers perfectly under serums, creams, and capsule cream for that full K-beauty glow ✨ What I love: • Hydrating and soothing • Skin looks smooth, soft, and glowy • No heavy scent (great for sensitive skin) • Works amazing with or without devices • Lightweight and non-sticky • Big 150 mL bottle + long shelf life If you want hydrated, glowing, glassy skin, this toner is such a good place to start. I’m obsessed 💗✨ 💖 Tip: Pat a thin layer in while your skin is still slightly damp — it absorbs deeper and gives a smoother glow! 🌸💦

avis.titre: Transformed My Skin Tone - Key to Achieving "Glass Skin!Transformed My Skin Tone - Key to Achieving "Glass Skin!
avis.texte: I am absolutely in love with the Medicube PDRN Toner with Salmon DNA! This milky toner has become an essential part of my skincare routine, and the results speak for themselves. There's a truly noticeable improvement in my overall skin tone since incorporating this product. The hydrating and moisturizing effects are immediate - my skin drinks this up and feels incredibly soothed thanks to the ceramide formula. The milky texture feels luxurious and absorbs beautifully without any sticky residue. One important note: I've found I need to be extra vigilant about applying my Medicube No Cast SPF when using this product due to increased photo sensitivity. This extra step is absolutely worth it for the amazing skin benefits! What truly impresses me is how this toner works synergistically with other products in the Medicube line. Together, they've helped me achieve that coveted "glass skin" look - clear, luminous, and with a beautiful healthy glow that I never thought possible for my skin. If you're looking to elevate your skincare routine with a product that delivers visible results, I highly recommend this PDRN Toner. It's been a game-changer for my skin!

avis.titre: Good but may need to adjust my routine with it
avis.texte: I got this milky toner a few weeks ago and have been using it as my morning toner and sometimes my night toner (I usually will use the equalberry toner at night when I had makeup on but otherwise try to use a hydrating toner). I will say that it has its moments. I feel like my skin has gotten more hydrated and glowy after putting this toner on but I haven't seen its full results yet. The main issues with this product if you can get past them are that you need to put it on with your hands and not a cotton pad and that if you put this on first, you will seal in any fibers or hairs you have on your face post-cleansing. I usually do a toner and an essence and whenever I do this toner first and then the essence, I will get fibers and hairs when I use the essence (on a cotton pad) and get some of the milky toner off too (even while waiting for the milky toner to sink in).

avis.titre: Caused breakouts but all skin is different
avis.texte: I have been having issues with my skin (redness- no blemishes) and decided to purchase this toner along with other Medicube PDRN products. After a few weeks and what seemed to be worse skin issues, I went and had a consult with an esthetician. Let me also say that I know it is sometimes normal for the skin to purge when introducing a new product into your skincare regimen. So I thought that was what I was experiencing. At my consult, I brought all my skincare products with me and she said that they were sufficient for the time being. I had a treatment with her the next day and a second a month later. She took pictures at my first appointment and when she compared that photo to my skin on the second appointment, she agreed that my skin did look worse than my first appointment (a lot of breakouts on my forehead, cheeks, and nose) and recommended that I discontinued the use of this product because she had seen in esthetician groups online that many people were reporting breakouts following the use of this toner. I followed her instructions and sure enough, the breakouts I was having cleared up. That being said, everyone’s skin is different. I have very sensitive, normal to dry skin and rosacea. So if you have the same type of skin, I would just be aware that any negative changes to your skin after introducing this product could be caused by it. This could be a five star product for some but it wasn’t the case for me.

avis.titre: The worst thing that ever happened to me 😬
avis.texte: I purchased some products from Medicube and COSRX, specifically the Medicube Toner, Toner Pad, Serum and the COSRX Snail Mucin 92% Moisturizer. After only two days of use, my face became hot, itchy, and swollen. I had to visit the hospital, and the doctor confirmed it was an allergic reaction. I have oily and sensitive skin, so these products didn’t work well for me. I hope the brands will be more careful with their formulas and do more testing for people with sensitive skin like mine. avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Soothing Toner for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: The Pink Niacinamide Milky Toner by Medicube is from a solid Korean skincare brand. It comes out as a pink liquid, thicker than most toners, and absorbs nicely into my skin. It feels cooling and calming to my face, and I didn't notice any odor. I have sensitive and combination skin. My skincare goals include minimizing pores, redness, and hyperpigmentation. After just one use, my face felt very hydrated without any noticable irritation. At the time of this review, the price ($20) is really good for the quality.

Not sure how glassy this makes skin, but the formula is definitely milky pink, absorbs nicely into my skin to leave it smooth. I look for products with niacinamide to help with my skin tone and clarity. I've only just started using PDRN products so looking forward to seeing if this helps with texture and elasticity. Ingredients list is pretty long and it does contain ethylhexyl palmitate near the top of the list, which can be comedogenic for some (I have pretty dry skin so it hasn't made me break out).
